content.short: claimr is an all-in-one gamification and marketing technology platform designed to drive user activation and automate rewards through on-chain quests.
content.description: claimr provides a comprehensive suite of white-label tools that allow projects to create engaging, gamified marketing campaigns. By automating rewards and verifying user actions across multiple blockchains, claimr helps communities grow through data-driven quests and instant prize distributions. Integrated with the Mantle Network, claimr enables ecosystem projects to launch high-performance campaigns with minimal fees and verifiable on-chain outcomes.
content.meta: claimr is a leading gamification and rewards platform for user activation on the Mantle Network. Discover claimr on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
